THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO ISSUE A WRIT OF MANDAMUS DIRECTING RESPONDENTS TO FINALIZE AND PASS AN AWARD FORTHWITH AND PAY THE COMPENSATION IN PURSUANCE OF THE FINAL NOTIFICATION BEARING NO. KAM.E/BHUSWA/2B/CR- 523/2022-23 DATED 13-11-2022 VIDE ANNEXURE-D AND TO CONSIDER THE REPRESENTATIONS OF THE PETITIONERS DATED 27-11-2023 TO RESPONDENT NO.1 VIDE ANNEXURE-G,
RESPONDENT NO. 2 VIDE ANNEXURE-H, RESPONDENT NO. 3 VIDE ANNEXURE-J, RESPONDENT NO. 4 VIDE ANNEXURE K, RESPONDENT NO. 5 VIDE ANNEXURE-L, RESPONDENT NO. 6 VIDE ANNEXURE-M,
AND DIRECT THE RESPONDENTS TO PASS AN AWARD U/S 25 OF THE ACT, 2013 WITHIN ONE MONTH AND PAY THE COMPENSATION STIPULATED PERIOD AND PAY THE COMPENSATION TO THE PETITIONERS WITHIN ONE MONTH FROM THE DATE OF AWARD IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:

Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and learned AGA appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 3, 5 and 6.
2.
The petitioners are before this Court seeking writ of mandamus to consider the representations referred to in the prayer marked at Annexures-G, H, J, K, L and M.

The petitioners claim that their lands have been acquired under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resetlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the '2013 Act').

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resetlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is also the case of the petitioners that the draft award is also prepared and same is not yet published.
The petitioners further claim that since last eight years, the names of the petitioners have been deleted from the property records on the pretext of lands being acquired.
It is further contented that the one year mandate prescribed under Section 23 of the 2013 Act will expire on 03.01.2024.
would submit that in exercise of powers under Section 25 of NC: 2023:KHC-D:14828 the 2013 Act, the time is extended to pass the final award.
It is further stated that extension order is passed on 28.11.2023 in writing.
4. It is also submitted that the draft award is prepared and same is to be published after following the procedure.

5. This being the position, considering the fact that the petitioners' names are not there in property records since last eight years, respondent Nos.1 to 3 and 5 are directed to take appropriate action on the draft award in accordance with law within three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed to that extent.
